summary: Clipper for drums, buses and masters: drive into a ceiling in dBFS, with a hard, soft (cubic), tanh or knee curve, 1× to 8× oversampling with antiderivative anti-aliasing, up to three bands (zero-latency Linkwitz–Riley crossovers, each band driven on its own), left/right or mid/side, mix, output, Delta (hear what it takes away) and a gain-match reading. No sample leaves above the ceiling at Mix 100 %; its latency is the same at every setting. Use it before a true-peak limiter to shave transients the limiter would pump on, or on drums for weight.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Gain into the clipper in 0.1 dB steps

parameters.name: Ceiling
parameters.description: Where it clips, dBFS (0.1 dB steps): no sample leaves above it at Mix 100 %

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: Hard: flat at the ceiling. Soft: a cubic that bends from 0 and reaches the ceiling at 1.5× it. Tanh: the tanh curve, the ceiling its asymptote. Knee: straight up to Knee under the ceiling, then a quadratic bend into it

parameters.name: Knee
parameters.description: Knee shape: where the bend starts, this far under the ceiling (0: hard)

parameters.name: Oversampling
parameters.description: Oversampling, with first-order antiderivative anti-aliasing from 2× (1×: the curve as it is, aliasing). The latency is the same at every setting

parameters.name: Bands
parameters.description: One band, or two or three split by Linkwitz–Riley crossovers (zero latency), each clipped on its own and summed, then clipped again

parameters.name: Crossover 1
parameters.description: Between the low and the next band (−6 dB here)

parameters.name: Crossover 2
parameters.description: Between the mid and the high band with three bands (never below Crossover 1)

parameters.name: Low drive
parameters.description: The low band's drive against Drive (bands only)

parameters.name: Mid drive
parameters.description: The middle band's drive against Drive (three bands)

parameters.name: High drive
parameters.description: The high band's drive against Drive (bands only)

parameters.name: Stereo
parameters.description: What is clipped: left and right, or mid and side (then left and right again at the ceiling)

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed to match). Below 100 % the dry signal can pass the ceiling

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the clipper, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the clipper changes: the output minus the input, delayed to match (gliding over 10 ms)

readings.description: Short-term loudness out − in (K-weighted, 3 s): what Output would have to take back for equal loudness
How far the driven signal went over the ceiling, at most
Samples the curve bent (over the knee, or the ceiling in Hard)
The clipper's latency, reported to NeoBuzz Live
